pysimdjson.upstream_commit_evidence: GitHub tag v8.0.0; csimdjson.pyx, simdjson.cpp, simdjson.h, util.cpp, __init__.py, pyproject.toml and LICENSE at that commit are byte-identical to the sdist
pysimdjson.wheel_note: Matching-platform reference wheel only; it is not installed. It contains one top-level csimdjson.cpython-311-aarch64-linux-gnu.so with simdjson compiled in, no bundled shared libraries, and the same simdjson sources as the sdist.

simdjson.release_evidence: simdjson/simdjson.h amalgamation banner 'version 5.1.1' and SIMDJSON_VERSION "5.1.1"; csimdjson.VERSION reports 5.1.1 at runtime
simdjson.license_evidence: upstream simdjson LICENSE and LICENSE-MIT (same as the C++ pilot); the amalgamation ships without separate license files in the sdist
simdjson.active_implementation_linux_arm64: arm64 (ARM NEON), selected by runtime dispatch; pyproject also defines SIMDJSON_IMPLEMENTATION_FALLBACK=1
simdjson.cpp_pilot_relation: Same simdjson DOM parser family as projects/json/cpp/simdjson, which pins simdjson 5.0.4; this binding vendors 5.1.1
